Verification method: Numerical diff check (max abs diff) between raw and processed arrays
Result: Tested on real data: max diff = 0.000000 across IRWIN, PMW TBs, rain, precipitable water
Remaining issue: 16-level 3D ERA5 wind/geopotential omitted to achieve compression.

Result: Tested on real data: 100% of matched overpasses satisfy t_env <= t_overpass (diff <= 0)
Remaining issue: 78 overpasses lacked preceding ERA5 slice and have has_causal_env = False.

Claim: Storm splits are 100% leak-free (56 Train, 12 Val, 12 Test)
Verification method: Set intersection on storm IDs across train, val, and test
Result: Tested on real data: Train ∩ Val = ∅, Train ∩ Test = ∅, Val ∩ Test = ∅
Remaining issue: Test split has 0 Category 2+ Hurricanes and 0 Extratropical cyclones due to small sample size.

Claim: Rapid Intensification defined as dV_24h >= 30 kt with 52 positives in pilot
Verification method: Audited index 8 of forward-differenced intensity change array
Result: Tested on real data: Exactly 52 positives among 1,784 valid labels (2.91%) reproduced
Remaining issue: Extreme class imbalance leads standard BCE to predict all zeros; requires pos_weight=10.

Claim: Future track targets extracted without interpolation or motion substitution
Result: Tested on real data: 402 valid +6h positions; never interpolated
Remaining issue: 84.5% missing because overpasses occur at off-synoptic times (>30 mins from 6h cycle).

Claim: TC-GraphFormer architecture processes 5 modalities and multi-task heads
Verification method: Unit tests and synthetic/real batch forward pass
Result: Unit-tested & Tested on real data: 1,439,046 params, forward pass validated without NaNs
Remaining issue: Spatial graph edge attributes use geometric coordinates; shear vector not yet embedded in edges.

Claim: Causal temporal transformer prevents future observation leakage
Verification method: Perturbed future token at t=2 and verified zero change at t=0 and t=1
Result: Unit-tested: Max diff at t=0 is 0.00000000; strict causality confirmed
Remaining issue: Revisit intervals range widely (1 to 24 hours); long gaps require continuous time decay.

Remaining issue: Heavy training must execute natively on Machine B via staged shards.
